ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the / day of _Ju, 2019, by and between J&B Realty LLC, a New York limited liability company (*Owner"), having an address at 11-10 43rd Road, Long Island City, New York 11101, and J&B Realty LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Developer"), having an address at 11-10 43rd Road, Long Island City, New York 11101. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York, of New York, and as and by the street address 11-10 43rd Road, Queens, New York, and more Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the “Existing Owner Building"; WHEREAS, Owner may demolish the Existing Owner Building and construct a new building or add additional floors to the Existing Owner Building, and construct other improvements associated with such new building and/or additional floors (the new building and improvements or the Existing Owner Building and such additional floors, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Existing Owner Building or the new Owner Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York, known as parts of Lots 1 and 12 in Block 445 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Queens, and as and by the street address 11-20 43rd Road, Queens, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the“Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, Developer may demolish the Existing Developer Building and construct a new building or add additional floors to the Existing Developer Building, and construct other improvements associated with such new building and/or additional floors (the new building and improvements or the Existing Developer Building and such additional floors, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Existing Developer Building or the new Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the"DeveloperParcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel KL33183298.7
